info.title: Completo API
info.description:
REST API for Completo — Kanban board management.

This spec covers endpoints useful for headless (non-browser) API usage. Frontend-internal endpoints (slug/key validation, UI column config, notifications, OAuth redirects, registration flows) are omitted.

Authenticate via session cookie (POST /auth/login) or Bearer token (create one at POST /api/user/tokens).

tags.name: Statuses
tags.description: Project-level workflow statuses and board column management

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Accounts for AI tools. An agent acts only through API tokens its manager or an admin generates, and its work is attributed to it. It can never sign in, be an admin or a project owner, create projects, manage members, or receive email or notifications. It can only be a member of projects its manager is a member of (an admin's agents: any project).

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: User management, settings, AI skills (admin only)

tags.name: MCP
tags.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Claude and other MCP clients. JSON-RPC 2.0 over POST (Streamable HTTP, stateless). Tools mirror the CLI: list_projects, get_project, list_cards, search_cards, get_card, create_card, update_card, move_card, assign_card, tag_card, list_comments, add_comment, my_tasks, create_project.

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization server for the MCP endpoint: authorization code with PKCE (S256), refresh token rotation, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591), client ID metadata documents, and discovery (RFC 8414, RFC 9728). The consent page is /oauth/authorize in the app.

post.description: Authenticates a user and starts a session.
Clears the user session.

get.description: Returns all API tokens for the authenticated user. Raw token values are not included.

post.description: Creates a new API token. The raw token is returned only once in the response. Use as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

expiresInDays.description: Days until expiration. Omit for non-expiring token.

token.description: Raw token value (only returned on creation)

get.description: Returns projects the current user is a member of, sorted alphabetically by name. Admins see all projects.

listCount.description: Number of list views in the project

starred.description: Whether the caller has starred this project, which puts it in their sidebar. Always false where the caller is not a member, including an admin's non-member projects.

post.description: Creates a new project with default statuses, tags, and a board. The creator becomes the owner. Agents cannot create projects (403).

briefing.description: Markdown project context sent to AI features

doneStatusName.description: Name of the default status to mark as done. Defaults to "Done".

doneRetentionDays.description: Days to keep done cards visible. null = unlimited. Default: 30.

get.description: Returns project details by ID or slug, including boards, statuses, tags, card counts, and priority breakdown.

isMember.description: Whether the caller is a member of the project. False for an admin viewing a project they are not in, whose `role` is still reported as owner-level access.

starred.description: Whether the caller has starred this project, which puts it in their sidebar. Always false where the caller is not a member, including an admin's non-member projects.

put.description: Updates project details. Owner or admin only.

doneStatusId.description: Status ID to mark as done, or null for none

doneRetentionDays.description: Days to keep done cards visible, or null for unlimited

delete.description: Deletes a project and all associated data. Owner or admin only.

put.description: Stars the project for the caller, which puts it in their sidebar. Idempotent. Members only: an admin who is not a member gets 403.

delete.description: Removes the caller's star from the project. Idempotent.

email.description: Null for an agent, except to the agent itself.

isAdmin.description: Present only for a caller who can remove members (a project owner or an admin): removing an admin keeps the agents they manage in the project. Always false for an agent.

assignedCardCount.description: For agents: cards assigned to it in this project, which leaving the project unassigns. Null for people.

post.summary: Add member or invite by email
post.description: Adds an existing user directly, or creates a pending invitation if the email is not registered. Owner or admin only. An agent can be added only while its manager is a member of the project (an admin's agents: any project; 403 otherwise), never while suspended (400), always as member, and is not emailed or notified.

email.description: User email to add or invite

patch.description: Changes a member's role between owner and member. Cannot demote the last owner. An agent cannot be made owner (400).

delete.description: Owner or admin; an agent's manager may also remove their own agent. Removing a person also removes the agents they manage from the project (unless they are an admin). An agent leaving a project has its cards there unassigned.

get.description: Returns non-expired pending invitations for the project. Owner or admin only.

post.description: Resends an invitation email with a fresh token and reset expiry.
Creates a project-level status (not linked to any board). Owner or admin only.

delete.description: Deletes a project-level status and its board links. Cards are never deleted: a status holding cards is refused with 409 unless `moveToStatusId` names another status in the same project, in which case its cards move there first. The project's last remaining status cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: moveToStatusId
parameters.description: Where the status's cards go. Required only when it holds any; may also be sent in the request body.

moveToStatusId.description: Another status in the same project. Its cards are appended after that status's existing cards.

movedToStatusId.description: Where they went, or null when the status was empty.

409.description: The status holds cards and no destination was given (`data.cardCount` says how many), or it is the project's last status

post.description: Creates a new board and links all existing project statuses.

get.description: Returns board with columns (statuses), cards, members, project info, tags, and available (unlinked) statuses. Done retention filtering is applied.

parameters.name: projectSlug
parameters.description: Scope board slug lookup to project

availableColumns.description: Project statuses not currently linked to this board

tagFilters.description: Tag IDs used to filter cards on this board

hiddenCardFields.description: Fields this board's cards do not display at rest. Unknown values are ignored. Hiding a field does not remove its editor, which stays available on card hover.

delete.description: Deletes the board and its status links. Project-level statuses and cards are preserved.

post.description: Creates a project-level status and links it to this board.

delete.description: Removes the status from this board. The project-level status and its cards are preserved.

columns.description: Field names. Defaults to ticketId, title, status, priority, assignee, tags.

tagFilters.description: Tag IDs to filter cards in this list

get.description: Returns list with columns, cards, members, statuses, and tags.

200.description: List with columns, cards, members, statuses, tags

tagFilters.description: Tag IDs used to filter cards in this list

role.description: Current user's role in the project

get.description: Searches title and description (LIKE, case-insensitive) and card ID across every project the caller can see — their memberships, or all projects for an instance admin. Supports ticket slugs (e.g. "TK-42"). Text queries need 2 characters; a bare card ID may be shorter. Returns at most 10 — exact ID matches first, then title matches, each most-recently-updated first.

isDone.description: Whether the card sits in its project's done status.

snippet.description: The part of the description this query matched, flattened to one line of prose and capped at ~260 characters. Null when the card has no description.

get.description: Returns card details by numeric ID or ticket slug (e.g. "TK-42"). Includes assignee, project, statuses, members, and tags.

put.description: Moves a card to a new status and/or position. Position renumbering is transactional.

get.description: Searches by title (LIKE) and card ID. Supports ticket slugs (e.g. "TK-42"). Min 2 characters.

put.description: Full replacement of tags on a card. All tag IDs must belong to the card's project.

post.description: Uploads a file to a card. Max size and allowed types are server-configured (UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_MB, UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES).

200.description: File content. Content-Type is derived from the file extension and sent with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Content-Disposition is inline only for images, PDF and plain text; every other type, including SVG, is served as attachment.

emailNotifications.description: Whether the user receives card-activity emails (assigned / mentioned).
Turn card-activity emails (assigned / mentioned) on or off.

put.description: Agents cannot edit themselves (403); their manager edits them through PATCH /api/agents/{id}.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account. Requires password confirmation. Admin accounts cannot self-delete. Agents cannot delete themselves (403). Suspends every agent the caller manages: they keep their memberships, lose their tokens, and have no manager until an admin transfers them.

get.description: Returns cards assigned to the current user grouped by project. Not admin-elevated.
Admin only. People only: agents are listed under GET /api/agents.

agentCount.description: Agents this person manages, suspended ones included.

activeAgentCount.description: Agents this person manages that are not suspended. Non-zero means removing their permission needs a hand-over first.

post.description: Creates a user with unusable password and sends setup email. Bypasses domain allowlist.

patch.description: Suspend/unsuspend, promote/demote admin, or allow/disallow creating agents. Cannot self-modify, and refuses agents (400). Returns 409 when the change would leave the person unable to manage agents (suspended, demoted without canCreateAgents, or canCreateAgents revoked) while they still manage active agents; hand them over first. Demoting an admin, or giving someone back the ability to manage agents, removes their agents (suspended ones too) from projects they are not a member of, listed in `removedFrom`.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a user account. Admin only. Refuses agents (400; use DELETE /api/agents/{id}), and returns 409 while the person still manages active agents.

post.description: Resends account setup email for an admin-created user pending setup.

get.description: Returns non-expired project invitations for non-registered users.

allowedEmailDomains.description: Allowed email domains for registration. Empty = unrestricted.

get.description: Returns skills available to the current user (without prompt content).
Returns all AI skills with full details including prompts.

post.description: Generates or improves a card description using AI. Streams response via SSE. Project briefing is automatically included as context.

mode.description: Legacy mode (ignored if skillId or userPrompt provided)

post.description: Creates a new card in the project. The status must belong to this project.

get.description: Returns all cards in a project with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. Applies done-card retention filtering by default.

parameters.name: dueBefore
parameters.description: Filter cards with due date on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: dueAfter
parameters.description: Filter cards with due date on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

parameters.name: includeDone
parameters.description: Include done cards past the retention window (default: false)

404.description: Project not found or user is not a member

get.description: Listing a card's comments marks the card as read for the caller, clearing its unread indicator. Pass markRead=false to read them without doing so.

parameters.name: markRead
parameters.description: false leaves the card's unread state untouched

post.description: Creates a comment on a card. Mentioned project members and the card assignee receive an in-app notification; the author is never notified about their own comment.

get.description: Who changed what on a card, and when: status (including moves between columns), assignee, priority, due date, title, tags added and removed, attachments added and removed, and that the description was edited (never its text). The first entry is the card's creation. Oldest first within a page; pages run backwards from the newest, so pass the first event's `id` as `before` to read the page before it. History starts with the release that added it: changes made earlier were not recorded.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events per page, from 1 to 500. Defaults to 200.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return only events older than this event id.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Read forward instead: only events newer than this event id (0 for all), oldest first, never the `created` entry. Cannot be combined with `before`. How an open timeline fetches only what is new.

200.description: One page of the card's history, oldest first

hasMore.description: Whether there are older events than this page, or with `after`, newer ones. When false on a backwards read, the page starts with the `created` entry.

total.description: How many entries the card's whole history has, the `created` entry included, whichever page this is.

projectId.description: The card's project, whose live event stream announces new entries.

put.description: Only the comment author may edit it — not project owners or admins, since a rewritten comment would stay attributed to its original author. Editing notifies newly added mentions only.

delete.description: The comment author, a project owner, or an instance admin may delete it. Owner-level deletion exists so inappropriate content can be removed without deleting the card, and is the only way to clear a comment whose author has deleted their account.

post.description: One JSON-RPC message or a batch per request, answered with JSON. Supported methods: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call; notifications are accepted with 202. Authenticate with a Bearer token in the Authorization header: an API token, or an OAuth access token from the sign-in flow (see the OAuth tag); a 401 carries WWW-Authenticate with resource_metadata. GET and DELETE answer 405: the server is stateless and issues no session id.

200.description: JSON-RPC response (or an array for a batch)

400.description: Not JSON, or not a JSON-RPC message

get.description: Also served at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.

200.description: The resource and its authorization server

redirect_uris.description: https URLs, or http on localhost

201.description: client_id, and client_secret for a confidential client

post.description: grant_type=authorization_code (code, redirect_uri, code_verifier, client_id, optional resource) or grant_type=refresh_token (refresh_token, client_id). Form-encoded or JSON. Confidential clients authenticate with client_secret in the body or HTTP Basic. Refresh rotates both tokens.

200.description: access_token (1 hour), refresh_token (30 days), token_type Bearer

post.summary: Revoke an access or refresh token (RFC 7009)

200.description: Always, whether or not the token existed
Array of grants: id, clientName, createdAt, lastUsedAt, refreshExpiresAt

get.description: The agents the caller manages. Admins can list every agent with `scope=all` or a `managerId`.

parameters.name: managerId
parameters.description: A manager's user ID, or `none` for agents without one. Admin only unless it is the caller.

post.description: Admins and people with canCreateAgents. The caller becomes the agent's manager. Create a token next: an agent with none can do nothing.

name.description: Unique among agents, case-insensitively. At most 100 characters.

get.description: Its manager or an admin; 404 for anyone else.

patch.description: Its manager or an admin. Send any of name, description, colour.

name.description: Unique among agents, case-insensitively. At most 100 characters.

delete.description: Its manager or an admin. Its tokens and memberships go; its cards become unassigned; its comments stay.

post.description: Its manager or an admin. The raw token is returned only once. Refused while the agent is suspended (409). At most 25 per agent.

expiresInDays.description: Days until expiration. Omit for non-expiring token.

token.description: Raw token value (only returned on creation)

post.description: Its manager or an admin. Revokes every token the agent holds; unsuspending needs a new one.

Its manager or an admin. Refused (409) while the agent has no manager or its manager can no longer manage agents; an admin transfers it first. Removes the agent from any project its manager is not a member of (none for an admin manager), listed in `removedFrom`.
Admin only. Hands the agent to a new manager and removes it from every project that person is not a member of (none for an admin), listed in `removedFrom`. A suspended agent stays suspended.

toUserId.description: An active admin, or a person with canCreateAgents.

post.description: Admin only. POST /api/agents/{id}/transfer for several agents at once.

toUserId.description: An active admin, or a person with canCreateAgents.

post.description: An admin, or the manager of every agent named (404 otherwise). Revokes all their tokens.

get.description: Admin only. Active admins and people with canCreateAgents. With `agentIds`, each candidate carries the memberships those agents would lose by moving to them.

post.description: Admin only. Transfers every agent the person manages to one new manager, or suspends them all, before the person is deleted, suspended or loses the permission.

get.summary: List agents that can be added
get.description: Owner or admin. Active agents that are not members yet and whose manager is a member of this project or an admin.
Cards assigned to the agents the caller manages, in projects the caller can see, with the agent as `assignee`. Done cards past retention are left out.

200.description: Cards held by the caller's agents

agentsWithCards.description: Of those, how many hold at least one card here.

bearerAuth.description: API token (create via POST /api/user/tokens, or for an agent via POST /api/agents/{id}/tokens)

hiddenCardFields.description: Fields this board's cards do not display at rest. Empty means every field is shown.

position.description: Position of the status when used as a board column

dueDate.description: Due date (date only, stored as timestamp)

attachmentCount.description: Number of file attachments on this card

commentCount.description: Number of comments on this card

creator.description: The user who created the card. Null if their account was deleted, or the card predates creator tracking.

mimeType.description: Server-determined content type, derived from the file extension. The Content-Type sent with the upload is not preserved — an unrecognised extension becomes application/octet-stream.

uploader.description: Who uploaded the file. Null if their account was deleted.

body.description: Markdown. User mentions are stored as `@[Display Name](ref)`, where ref is the first group of the user's UUID (8 hex chars); the full UUID is also accepted. An ambiguous ref resolves to nobody rather than guessing.

authorId.description: Null if the author has been deleted.

updatedAt.description: Greater than createdAt if the comment has been edited.

authorKind.description: `agent` for an account an AI tool acts through (see the Agents tag).

authorManagedBy.description: The person responsible for an agent. Null for people, and for an agent whose manager was deleted.

body.description: Markdown comment body. Must not be empty. User mentions are stored as `@[Display Name](ref)`, where ref is the first group of the user's UUID (8 hex chars); the full UUID is also accepted. An ambiguous ref resolves to nobody rather than guessing.

kind.description: `agent` for an account an AI tool acts through (see the Agents tag).

color.description: Avatar tint an agent's creator picked (hex). Null for people.

managedBy.description: The person responsible for an agent. Null for people, and for an agent whose manager was deleted.

UserSummary.description: A person or an agent wherever one is named: assignee, creator, uploader. Never carries an email address.

MemberSummary.description: A project member as the assignee and mention pickers need it. The extra fields are for agents and are null or false for people.

description.description: What the agent does; shown where a person shows an email.

suspended.description: A suspended agent is left out of pickers.

lastSeenAt.description: When the agent last used a token.

LostMembership.description: A project an agent leaves because its new manager is not a member there.

lastSeenAt.description: When a token of the agent was last used.

email.description: The agent's synthetic address on agents.invalid. Never mailed; set it as COMPLETO_USER for the CLI's --me. Returned only here and to the agent itself.

CardEvent.description: One change to a card. Every change is its own event, never merged with the one before however close together they were, ordered by `id`.

id.description: Increases with every change, so it is the exact order even where two share a millisecond. 0 for the `created` entry, which is read off the card and has no row of its own.

field.description: What changed. `status` includes moves between board columns; reordering within a status is not recorded. `tag` and `attachment` events have only `to` when one was added and only `from` when one was removed.

from.description: One side of a change. Null means none: unassigned, no due date, a tag or file the card did not have. `description` events carry no sides at all: they record that the text changed, never the text.

id.description: The status, person, tag or attachment this side names. Null for plain values (priority, title, due date).

value.description: The name the status, person or tag has now, or, once it has been deleted, the name it had when the change was made. For priority and title the value itself; for a due date an ISO 8601 date-time; for an attachment its file name.

to.description: One side of a change. Null means none: unassigned, no due date, a tag or file the card did not have. `description` events carry no sides at all: they record that the text changed, never the text.

id.description: The status, person, tag or attachment this side names. Null for plain values (priority, title, due date).

value.description: The name the status, person or tag has now, or, once it has been deleted, the name it had when the change was made. For priority and title the value itself; for a due date an ISO 8601 date-time; for an attachment its file name.

actor.description: Who made the change: the signed-in person, or the agent whose token made the request. A change a request caused on other cards (a deleted status moving its cards, a removed member's agents leaving, a deleted account or tag) is attributed to whoever made that request. Null once the account is deleted.

actorName.description: The actor's name when the change was made, so a deleted account is still named. Null only on a `created` entry whose creator is gone.

createdAt.description: When the change was made, to the millisecond.

BadRequest.description: Bad request — invalid or missing parameters
